assertions.assertion: Calls AddJwtBearer with Authority set to 'https://identity.example.com'
assertions.rationale: AddJwtBearer sets options.Authority from config with the https://identity.example.com comment.

assertions.assertion: Sets TokenValidationParameters.ValidTypes to include 'at+jwt' to prevent JWT confusion attacks
assertions.rationale: ValidTypes = new[] { "at+jwt" } is set inside TokenValidationParameters.

assertions.assertion: Includes UseAuthentication() before UseAuthorization() in the middleware pipeline

assertions.rationale: Includes the dotnet add package Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer command.
